hooks.command: if ! command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[claude-hook] WARNING: deno not found on PATH; required for supabase/functions/ work (fmt/lint/check/test) and not auto-installed. See CLAUDE.md for setup/TLS notes." >&2; fi; if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo "[claude-hook] node_modules/ missing; starting npm install in the background (log: .git/claude-npm-install.log)." >&2; (npm install --no-audit --no-fund > .git/claude-npm-install.log 2>&1 &) ; fi; true
